item.title: security: ​​Microsoft named a Leader in the KuppingerCole Leadership Compass for Cloud Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP)
item.description:
Microsoft says KuppingerCole named it a Leader in the Leadership Compass for Cloud Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP). The provided excerpt does not include technical changes or product updates beyond that recognition.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: 5 insights from Frost & Sullivan’s 2025 Frost Radar™ for Cloud Security Posture Management
item.description:
Microsoft summarizes five takeaways from Frost & Sullivan’s 2025 Frost Radar for Cloud Security Posture Management, highlighting a shift from point-in-time compliance to continuous risk management. The post frames CSPM as evolving toward broader, ongoing cloud security oversight.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Microsoft named a leader in the Frost Radar for cloud and application runtime security
item.description:
Microsoft says Frost & Sullivan named it a leader in the Frost Radar for cloud and application runtime security. The post frames this as recognition for a unified approach to cloud and application security focused on runtime risk reduction.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: CNAPP evolution: How Microsoft aligns with leading cloud risk management platforms
item.description:
Microsoft’s post says CNAPP platforms are increasingly used to prioritize exploitable risks, reduce exposure, and embed security across the application lifecycle. It positions Microsoft’s approach as aligned with other leading cloud risk management platforms.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
